· MACD histogram trajectory (hist -0.2393 → -0.2662) + continued worsening, bearish convergence signal

· Swing resistance ($70.13) + short-term resistance zone, potential trend reversal upon breakout

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to continued short-term selling pressure
